description:
Frontend Developer (Freelance)

Neho is seeking a talented and experienced Frontend Developer to join our team on a freelance basis. If you are passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and have a keen eye for detail, we want to hear from you. This position is remote.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing user-friendly web pages using markup languages like HTML and CSS
  • Implementing responsive design for various devices and screen sizes
  • Collaborating with back-end developers to improve usability
  • Optimizing applications for maximum speed and scalability
  • Ensuring web design is optimized for cross-browser compatibility

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years experience in a similar role
  • Proven work experience as a Frontend Developer
  • Proficient understanding of web markup, including HTML5, CSS3 and web standards
  • Experience with CSS frameworks like Bootstrap or Tailwind are a must
  • Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue is an advantage
  • Knowledge of code versioning tools like Git
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Benefits:

  • Flexible working hours and the ability to work remotely
  • Opportunity to collaborate with a dynamic and creative team
  • Room for growth and skill development in a supportive environment
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and skills

If you are looking to showcase your frontend development skills in a challenging yet rewarding freelance role, apply now to be part of our innovative projects.

Please note that this is not a JS framework based role, knowing React is an advantage, but you will mostly be doing markup integration, components creation for both framework and non framework agnostic elements, SASS code, Laravel Blade integration. You will be working a lot with backend developers to ensure proper integration into the existing solution and templating system.
